plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Adresse affichée pour ce lieu. Vous pouv: Address displayed for this place. You can correct it if the one given by Škoda is wrong
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Aucun autre lieu pour le moment : ils s\: No other place yet: one is added each time the car parks outside a favourite.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Aucun favori pour le moment. Ajoutez-en: No favourite yet. Add one above, or name a place in the list below and click its star.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Aucun trajet aujourd\\'hui : la carte mo: No trip today: the map shows the last day the car was driven. The “Today” button brings you back here.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Aucun trajet ce jour-là. Les points gris: No trip on that day. The grey dots are places where the car parked on previous days, not trips of that day. Change the day with the arrow to see the trips of another day.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Aucun véhicule actif. Ajoutez-en un : me: No active vehicle. Add one: Plugins menu, Connected objects, MySkoda, “Add a vehicle”.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Aucun véhicule actif. Un véhicule s\\'aj: No active vehicle. A vehicle is added from the desktop version of Jeedom: Plugins menu, Connected objects, MySkoda, “Add a vehicle”.
No charging session over this period.

This place is no longer a favourite.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Ces deux boutons ouvrent la version ordi: These two buttons open the desktop version of Jeedom: this is where you add a vehicle and configure the plugin.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Cherchez l\\'adresse, ou cliquez directe: Search for the address, or click directly on the map at the desired spot. One click moves the point. The address you type is the one that will be displayed.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Cliquez pour en faire un favori : tous l: Click to make it a favourite: every parking stop within its radius will be attached to it
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Couleur de ce favori sur les cartes: Colour of this favourite on the maps
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Créer le favori « Maison » aux coordonné: Create the “Home” favourite at the home coordinates known to Jeedom
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Descendre ce favori dans la liste: Move this favourite down the list
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Facultatif : prix du kWh à cet endroit,: Optional: price per kWh at this place, if you charge there. Empty: the general price from the plugin configuration
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Facultatif : prix du litre à cet endroit: Optional: price per litre at this place, if you refuel there. Empty: the general price from the plugin configuration
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Facultatif : rayon de ce favori en mètre: Optional: radius of this favourite in metres. Empty: the general radius set in the plugin configuration
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Favori : cliquez pour le retirer des fav: Favourite: click to remove it from the favourites
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Glisser pour changer l\\'ordre des favor: Drag to change the order of the favourites
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.L\\'adresse affichée correspond déjà à c: The displayed address already matches this point.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.L\\'adresse de ce point n\\'a pas été tr: The address of this point was not found. You can correct it by hand in the list.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.L\\'adresse saisie est envoyée par votre: The address you enter is sent by your Jeedom to the OpenStreetMap search service to be located on the map
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.La bibliothèque de cartes n\\'a pas pu ê: The map library could not be loaded.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.La voiture est revenue à son point de dé: The car came back to its starting point: the map shows it as a blue circle around the place, since the route is not known.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Le journal de bord ne peut pas se rempli: The logbook cannot be filled: history logging is unticked for
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Le journal est reconstitué à partir de l: The logbook is rebuilt from the Jeedom history; times are those at which the car sent its data. It starts empty on the day the plugin is installed: Škoda provides no history.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Le nom d\\'un lieu remplace son adresse: The name of a place replaces its address in the logbook, on the tile and in the “Place” command, which can be used in scenarios. To give a place the name of another one, pick it from the list of the “Name” field: two places with the same name are shown under that name and count as one place in trips; each keeps its own price, and only the one marked with a star has a radius. The general radius of favourites is set in the plugin configuration; each favourite can have its own, wider in the countryside or for an underground car park, tighter in town. The price entered on a place applies to charging sessions or refuelling done there; elsewhere, the price from the plugin configuration is used.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Le point rouge est l\\'emplacement enreg: The red dot is the saved location. If it is misplaced, click on the map to move it. Then confirm: the address of this point will be suggested to you.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Les lieux où la voiture se gare sont mém: The places where the car parks are remembered automatically. Here you name them, correct their address, and create your favourite places (Home, Work, School…): any parking stop within the radius of a favourite is attached to it, even if the position sent by the car is slightly off.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Les trajets de ce jour n\\'ont pas de dé: The trips of this day have no located start or end: they cannot be drawn.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Les valeurs sont les dernières reçues ;: The values are the last ones received; a trip or charging session in progress will end at the right time once Škoda answers again.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Monter ce favori dans la liste: Move this favourite up the list
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Nom donné à ce lieu. La liste propose le: Name given to this place. The list suggests names already in use
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Placez d\\'abord le point : cherchez l\\: Place the point first: search for the address, or click on the map.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Point placé. Cliquez ailleurs sur la car: Point placed. Click elsewhere on the map to move it.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Points de couleur entourés d\\'un cercle: Coloured dots with a circle: your favourites and their radius. Grey dots: the other places. Green dot with a white ring: the car. Click a place, here or in the list, to see it up close and refine its location.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Points gris : tous les lieux où la voitu: Grey dots: every place where the car has ever parked, whatever the day. Coloured dots: your favourites. Green dot with a white ring: its current position. Blue lines: trips of the selected day only, drawn as the crow flies between start and end, because Škoda does not provide the route. Dashed blue circle: round trip back to its starting point. Red dots: charging sessions or refuelling of the selected day.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Pour la rétablir : page de l\\'équipemen: To restore it: device page, Commands tab, “Log history” box of these commands, then Save. The logbook will resume from that moment; what happened in the meantime cannot be recovered.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Pour obtenir les coûts, saisissez le pri: To get the costs, enter the price per kWh in the plugin configuration.
To get the costs, enter the price per litre of fuel in the plugin configuration.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Pour obtenir les kWh, saisissez la capac: To get the kWh, enter the battery capacity on the device.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Pour obtenir les litres, saisissez la co: To get the litres, enter the fuel tank capacity on the device.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Recherche de l\\'adresse de ce point…: Looking up the address of this point…
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Réglages de ce lieu : prix, rayon, coule: Settings of this place: price, radius, colour, deletion
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Réponse illisible du serveur Jeedom. Rec: Unreadable answer from the Jeedom server. Reload the page; if it persists, check the plugin log.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Saisissez une adresse, ou cliquez sur la: Enter an address, or click on the map to place the point.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Si le point n\\'est pas exactement au bo: If the point is not exactly in the right spot, click on the map to move it.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Supprimer ce lieu ? Les trajets déjà enr: Delete this place? Trips already recorded are not changed.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Valider ce point et vérifier son adresse: Confirm this point and check its address
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Voir ce lieu sur la carte et affiner son: See this place on the map and refine its location
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.les stationnements faits ici sont rattac: parking stops made here are attached to this favourite. Delete this place, or reduce the radius of the favourite.
plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/journal.js.Škoda ne fournit plus les données du véh: Škoda has not been providing the vehicle data since

plugins/myskoda/desktop/js/myskoda.js.Numéro de série (VIN) du véhicule : 17 c: Vehicle identification number (VIN): 17 characters, shown in the MyŠkoda app and on the vehicle registration document

plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.17 caractères, visibles sur la carte gri: 17 characters, shown on the vehicle registration document and in the MyŠkoda app
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Aucun véhicule. Saisissez la clé API dan: No vehicle. Enter the API key in the plugin configuration, then click “Add a vehicle”
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Autoriser la climatisation sur la batter: Allow air conditioning on battery power, car not plugged in
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Charge pilotée par un scénario (surplus: Charging driven by a scenario (solar surplus, home battery, off-peak hours)
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Date à laquelle l\\'entretien est dû: Date on which the service is due
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Décoché (par défaut) : le plugin ne dema: Unticked (default): the plugin asks for nothing in particular, the car's own setting decides. Ticked: when the plugin starts the air conditioning, it asks the car to heat or cool even if it is not plugged in, so on its battery, which reduces the range
Optional, for a combustion vehicle. Used by the logbook to convert fuel percentages into litres
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Facultatif. Code à 4 chiffres de ce véhi: Optional. 4-digit code of this vehicle, the one its primary user defined for it. Škoda only requires it to start the auxiliary heating (parking heater of some combustion and hybrid vehicles). Not needed for charging or air conditioning of an electric vehicle. Stored encrypted, never written to the logs
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Facultatif. Sert au panneau pour convert: Optional. Used by the panel to convert battery percentages into kWh: Škoda does not provide this value
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Facultatif. À remplir si ce véhicule n'u: Optional. Fill in if this vehicle does not use the fuel of the general price in the plugin configuration (diesel, E85…)
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Jours restants indiqués par l\\'applicat: Days left as shown by the app: converted into a date when saved
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Kilomètres restants indiqués par l\\'app: Kilometres left as shown by the app: converted into a due mileage when saved
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Kilométrage auquel l\\'entretien est dû: Mileage at which the service is due
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Pour la tuile personnalisée seulement. L: For the customised tile only. The background is a gradient of this colour; on a light colour, the text turns dark
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Prix du litre pour ce véhicule: Price per litre for this vehicle
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Standard : la tuile habituelle, dans le: Standard: the usual tile, inside the Jeedom tile frame. Customised: a fixed-size tile (330 × 500) with a coloured background, meant for a design; it shows the essentials, and every command sent to the car asks for confirmation
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.À cocher si la charge de ce véhicule est: Tick this if this vehicle's charging is started and stopped by a scenario: solar surplus, home battery, off-peak hours. The logbook then counts a single charging session per cable connection, all resumptions included, instead of one session at each resumption. No effect on an ordinary charging session
plugins/myskoda/desktop/php/myskoda.php.Škoda ne transmet pas les échéances d'en: Škoda does not provide the service due dates: copy here those of the MyŠkoda app (Inspect, Service). The plugin then counts down the kilometres and days left and warns you when they come close. Enter either the due value or “in so many km / days”: the second form is converted when saved.

plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Application MyŠkoda : Profil, puis Maiso: MyŠkoda app: Profile, then Smart home. Tick the vehicles to follow there.
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Aucun véhicule pour l'instant. Enregistr: No vehicle yet. Save your API key below first, then open the “Vehicles” page to add yours.
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Clé créée dans l'application MyŠkoda (Pr: Key created in the MyŠkoda app (Profile, Smart home), ticking the vehicles to follow. It expires: its end date is in the “Key expiry” command
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Cochée, les commandes expérimentales son: When ticked, the experimental commands are created at the next reading of each vehicle that supports them. If you untick it later, these commands stay in place but are refused, so that your scenarios do not break: just tick the box again to get them back
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Copie automatique impossible : le rappor: Automatic copy not possible: the report is selected, copy it with Ctrl+C.
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Créez la clé sur votre téléphone: Create the key on your phone
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Délai entre l'envoi d'une commande (char: Delay between sending a command (charging, air conditioning) and the reading that shows its effect on the tile and in scenarios. Shorter, the state follows faster; too short, the car has not answered yet and the state will only change at the next reading
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Facultatif, pour les véhicules thermique: Optional, for combustion vehicles. Used by the logbook to estimate the cost of trips and refuelling. If a vehicle uses another fuel, its own price is entered on the device
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Facultatif. Sert au journal de bord pour: Optional. Used by the logbook to estimate the cost of trips and charging sessions. A price specific to a place (a public charger, for example) is entered in the logbook, “Places” tab
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Fonctions écrites d'après la documentati: Features written from Škoda's documentation but never tried on a vehicle. They are meant for people willing to try them and report back: the list and the tests to run are in the documentation.
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Le plugin ne demande ni identifiant ni m: The plugin asks for no Škoda login or password: it uses a key that you create yourself in the MyŠkoda app.
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Le rapport n\\'a pas pu être préparé: The report could not be prepared
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Lecture à l'arrêt et en charge: Reading while parked and while charging
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.MySkoda, par mortyre. Licence GPL versio: MySkoda, by mortyre. GPL version 3 licence. Independent project, not affiliated with Škoda Auto.
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Métrique : kilomètres, km/h, kWh ou litr: Metric: kilometres, km/h, kWh or litres per 100 km. Imperial: miles, mph, miles per kWh or miles per gallon (UK gallon). This setting applies to all vehicles and only changes the display of the tile, the logbook and its exports: command values stay in kilometres, your scenarios do not change. Temperatures stay in °C
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Rapport prêt : copiez-le ou téléchargez-: Report ready: copy or download it to attach it to your message.
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Rythme gardé encore 10 minutes après l'a: Rate kept for 10 more minutes after stopping, and during the 10 minutes following the start or end of a charging session. The faster the reading, the more finely trips are tracked. At 3 minutes, the whole quota goes into readings: almost nothing is left for commands
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Signe affiché à côté des prix et des coû: Symbol shown next to prices and costs, in the logbook and its exports. No amount is converted: enter your prices directly in your currency
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Son numéro de série (VIN) suffit : le pl: Its serial number (VIN) is enough: the plugin creates its commands at the first reading.
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Un stationnement fait à moins de cette d: A parking stop within this distance of a favourite place (Home, Work…) is attached to it. The position sent by the car can be off by more than a hundred metres at the same spot. Each favourite can have its own radius, set in the logbook, “Places” tab
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.puis enregistrez la configuration (bouto: then save the configuration (“Save” button at the top of the frame).
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.État du plugin et de chaque véhicule, à: State of the plugin and of each vehicle, to attach when you report a problem. It contains no key, S-PIN code, VIN, number plate, name, address or position
plugins/myskoda/plugin_info/configuratio.Škoda autorise 20 requêtes par heure et: Škoda allows 20 requests per hour and per vehicle, commands included: each command costs two (the command, then the re-reading one minute later). This rate also applies during a charging session, to keep requests for commands
Škoda allows 20 requests per hour and per vehicle, commands included. These rates share this quota between readings and commands.
